reference.method: manual native source-image grid review; no skeleton-candidate assets

conventions.headTransform: 2x3 affine maps original source frame0 native scalp coordinates to this source frame; preserves rotation and fits skull contour
conventions.faceTransform: independent pre-scalp similarity for source facial expression tracking; use featureGuides for local edits
conventions.foreground: visible source hand/forearm polygons; restore dressed foreground after hair, not all skin pixels
conventions.facePolygon: conservative inner-face edit envelope; excludes skull outline, ear, jaw boundary and neck
conventions.featureGuides: inferred authoring locations, not generated pixels or anatomical ground truth
conventions.sourceExpressions: preserve blink/half/laugh; gentle edits apply only to open-state frames
conventions.originalSource: original pixels, frame order, timing, body registration and ground anchor remain immutable
conventions.anchors: inferred feature guides projected inside observed source head bounds; source scalp affine remains independent
